project_name: THE VILLAGE — A Single-Parent & Family Support Network
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) blended with Swiss Editorial Precision
philosophy: It takes a village. Give what you can. Receive what you need. Nobody has to do it alone.
design_vision: Awwwards Site of the Day level editorial storytelling for a mutual aid network. Eliminates transactional coldness and patronizing charity vibes in favor of dignified solidarity, warm human textures, tactile paper-like grain, asymmetric Swiss grid tension, and reciprocal dignity.

sections_blueprint.description: Sticky crystal glass header with brand mark 'THE VILLAGE', tagline eyebrow 'Takes a Village', quick anchors to Exchange, Services, Safety, Businesses, Vision, and dual CTA buttons ('Join as Parent' / 'Become a Sponsor'). Includes mobile drawer.

Kinetic editorial hero. Primary display serif: 'A parent should not have to do everything alone.' Tagline: 'It takes a village. Give what you can. Receive what you need.' Side-by-side asymmetric composition with genuine photography, live ticker of verified village members, and quick interactive trigger to waitlist form.

Slow, organic running ticker with low-contrast earthy tones highlighting core principles: 'Reciprocal Dignity • 0% Transaction Fees • Vetted Safe Neighbors • Zero Stigma • Circles of Care • Child-First Trust • Real Mutual Aid'.

Interactive interactive simulator of 'The Village Exchange' points system. Two tabs: 'Give what you can' (grocery runs, tutoring, driving, laundry access) and 'Receive what you need' (earned Village Points, no shame, dignified exchange). Shows transparent points-math and real-life scenarios.

Bento-style layout of the 8 core coordinated services: Transportation, Laundry hubs, Food & household resources, School & activity carpools, Technology loans & repairs, Employment & resume coaching, Emotional support phone trees, and Children's life skills masterclasses.

Comprehensive Trust & Safety architecture: 4-tier verification protocol (Government ID, Criminal background screening, Driver license + active insurance check, extra pediatric/child-facing safety clearances, plus community vouching and peer ratings).

How local businesses anchor the village. Measurable community impact replacing useless advertising: Laundromats sponsoring 500 loads, local grocers underwriting fresh produce trips, hair salons sponsoring interview styling, dental clinics providing pediatric checkups. Interactive 'Impact Simulator' for business owners.

Spotlight on 'Village Business' designation for single-parent micro-entrepreneurs: home bakers, tailors, freelance tutors, auto handymen. Features the circular flywheel: from receiving free laundry to launching a small cleaning service, to sponsoring laundry for the next struggling mother.

Narrative arc step-by-step scrollytelling component: (1) Needing Help → (2) Receiving Without Stigma → (3) Gaining Breathing Room & Skills → (4) Paying It Forward to Another Family. Real-life testimonial timeline.

The Architectural Blueprint of the future Physical Community Center: Interactive floorplan map showing Resource Room, Kids Learning Den, Skill Classroom, Professional Interview Prep Hub, Free Laundry Facility, and Quiet Sanctuary.

Working dual-audience waitlist onboarding form connected to backend. Segmented tabs: 'I am a Parent / Family' vs 'I am a Business / Volunteer Sponsor'. Real-time form submission, role-specific tags, instant validation, and sonner toast confirmation.
Dark architectural footer with dramatic typography ('NOBODY HAS TO DO IT ALONE'), community charter principles, emergency resources hotline, privacy safeguards, and copyright.
